_comment: The forward book: what the rest of the year is expected to bring, set by the user in conversation and stored as data (SYNTHETIC example values). expected_income: a monthly amount over an inclusive YYYY-MM range, counts into profit AND revenue for the months still ahead. planned_purchases: a one-off cost with the month it must land by, counts into profit only. offbook: a signed yearly amount that never appears in the ledger (e.g. a workroom deduction declared elsewhere) and counts only into thresholds with include_offbook true.
